title: Private deploy bootstrap: health-validation pipeline for API and model-load smoke tests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an automated bootstrap validation pipeline that runs immediately after a private (VPC/on-prem) deployment completes. The pipeline will verify API readiness, validate model artifact loading (including quantized variants), and run a focused smoke + synthetic load sequence to surface regressions in KV-cache warmup, kernel scheduling, and TLS/mTLS networking. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, Terraform outputs validation, and actionable alerting hooks for failures.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can be triggered automatically by the deployment orchestration (Terraform/Terraform Cloud or GitHub Actions) using exported outputs and secrets
API readiness check returns 200 on /v1/health and validates response schema and service PID/commit metadata
Model load test successfully loads the selected model variant into the runtime within configured timeout (default 60s) and reports peak GPU memory and KV cache size
Synthetic smoke runner issues short generation and chat requests (streaming + non-streaming) and asserts correct functional responses and latency SLOs
KV cache priming step runs a short token-prefix workload and verifies next-token generation speed improves vs cold baseline
Terraform module outputs (subnet ids, instance ids, security group ids) are validated against the cluster control plane API and failures are reconciled or surfaced
Failed runs create a GitHub issue template and post a summary to #private-deploy-alerts Slack with a link to the pipeline run and logs
Runbook section added to Confluence with triage steps, known false positives, and remediation commands
implementation_steps: Add a terraform output validator script that takes TF state JSON and checks required resources are present and healthy
Build a small 'bootstrap-agent' container that runs API readiness checks, model load orchestration (via runtime API), and synthetic request generation
Integrate the bootstrap-agent into the deployment pipeline (GitHub Actions runner for small clusters, Terraform Cloud run tasks for larger infra)
Create lightweight synthetic workloads: short prefix generation, chat turn with tool-calling disabled, and embedding vector sanity check
Add logging to capture GPU memory timeline and kernel selection logs during model load
Wire failure hooks: create GitHub issue with labels, notify Slack channel, and attach pre-signed log archive URL
Add configuration flags for timeouts, model variant, and whether to run KV priming versus skipping (for faster iterates)
Document the bootstrap pipeline and hand over runbook to SRE/solutions engineers
comments: 2026-02-21 - Aisha Patel: Ticket created after last week's staging outage where model failed to warm due to kernel selection mismatch. Proposed a short automated pipeline to catch these earlier.

2026-02-25 - Liam Chen: Prototype bootstrap-agent container built; can hit /v1/health and request model load on local dev cluster. Observed 85% slower model load when quantized weights were on NFS vs local SSD — adding a check for expected storage class.
2026-03-02 - Marisol Gomez (SRE): Suggested adding GPU memory timeline export to assist kernel-level debugging. Also requested Slack alert verbosity to include node affinity and instance type.

2026-03-06 - Liam Chen: Integrated terraform-output validator; it compares TF state to control-plane inventory API and flags mismatched security groups. Found one environment with missing route53 private zone entries — creating follow-up ENG-21447.

2026-03-10 - Liam Chen: KV priming step added. Ran end-to-end on staging cluster: all checks passed except one transient streaming handshake failure (retry succeeded). Captured logs and created follow-up to harden streaming backoff logic. Preparing PR for internal review.
